title: bupleurum queri
intro: Bupleurum queri, commonly known as Hare's ear, is a plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae. This plant is valued for its traditional use in Chinese medicine, where it is considered to have various health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation, relieve fever, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Bupleurum queri include its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and immunomodulatory properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as arthritis, bronchitis, and the common cold. The bioactive constituents of Bupleurum queri include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often extracted and used in herbal remedies.
